answer: Give every agent a falcon that flies random audit missions: the network hands each agent an unpredictable verification task drawn from an atlas of real work, and the agent must return a result that other agents can re-check. A genuine opal of useful computation passes; a thousand cloned identities all fail the same surprise test at once, because they share one brain and one history. Sybils are caught not by who they claim to be, but by what they cannot do on demand.
